answer: 🏛️  Library Hours:  • Monday to Friday:  7:00 AM – 6:00 PM  (NO NOON BREAK) • All checkouts are due  24 hours after checkout .

📚  Loan Privileges:  •  Students:  Up to  3 books  of different titles. •  Faculty:  Up to  5 books  of different titles. • All checkouts are due  24 hours after checkout . •  Note:  Books marked "NOT FOR HOME USE" & General Reference are strictly for room-use only.
⏳  Returning Policy:  All checked-out books are due  24 hours after checkout . Returns are accepted during the library's 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM operating hours.

💰  Overdue Fines:  •  ₱1.50 per started overdue hour , capped at  ₱10.00 per started 24-hour overdue period . • ⚠️ Borrowers with unpaid fines cannot borrow additional materials until their account is settled.

🔍  Lost Book Policy:  1. Report the lost book immediately to the Circulation Librarian. 2. Overdue fines will  freeze  as of the date reported. 3. You are granted a grace period of  2 weeks  to locate or replace the item. 4. If not replaced within 2 weeks, overdue fines will resume until settled.

👥  EVSU Library Personnel:  •  Romulo Joseph M. Jereza, IV, RL, MLIS  — Supervising Librarian •  Neña Divina D. Fevidal, RL, MLIS  — Librarian Designate •  Ivan Jarvis C. Becamon  — Library Assistant •  Jacqueline P. Duero  — Library Assistant •  Ronel P. Mas  — Library Assistant
⚖️  Disciplinary Sanctions:  •  1st Offense:  1-week suspension of library privileges •  2nd Offense:  1-month suspension of library privileges •  3rd Offense:  1 semester / trimester suspension

🎯  EVSU Library Quality Mission:   "Complementing the teaching-learning process by providing effective and efficient library resources services to the students, faculty and staff of the University in support of its philosophy, goals and objectives."

🏛️  Library Sections & Services:  •  6 Sections:  General Reference, Periodicals, Reserved, Circulation, New Books Display, E-Section. •  6 Services:  Lending, Reference/Information, Current Awareness, Referral, Library Orientation, and Internet/OPAC Services.

🪪  Library ID & Requirements:  A validated EVSU School ID / Library ID must be presented upon entering and during every borrowing transaction at the Circulation counter. Library IDs are non-transferable.
